{{Quote|We found the pilots, Colonel. Two droids, one protocol, one a heavyweight hauler.|Unidentified military policeman to Kadana Sorrel|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]] [[Galactic Alliance Military Police|Military Police]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he was stationed aboard [[Rimsaw Station]] in orbit of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] when two unidentified [[X-wing starfighter|X-wings]] had a brief [[Mission to Kuratooine|dogfight]] against two [[E-wing starfighter|E-wings]] of the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit within the Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] that had a [[Chakham Army Base|base]] on the planet. After vaping the E-wings, the X-wings flew down to [[Kura City]], and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kadana Sorrel]] of Starfighter Command received a message telling her to come down to the planet to investigate the disturbance.<ref name="MK" />

Considering the incident to be within Starfighter Command's jurisdiction, Sorrel flew down to the planet in a shuttle and traced the [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder]] signals near the [[Old Kura City Courthouse Plaza]]. She was accompanied by troopers from the Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|navy]] and her own military police, which included the corporal. After landing, she ordered her troops to search the area for X-wing [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] or anyone suspicious. Later, the corporal found two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] wearing X-wing [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suits]] and reported them to Sorrel, despite knowing they were decoys.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified Starfighter Command military policeman was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
